title: LING
summary: "Ling" (靈): Derived from oracle bone script, (雨) rain from above, in the middle is (口) mouth, Shaman(巫) down below. The Shaman's persistent prayer for rain, with "Ling" can also extend to refer to sacred spirits.
paragraphs: HD Live Moving Graphics, Stereo Sound, Projection, Stage Lighting, Fabric (6m*2m), Clay, 20:00
